div.div: أَحْرَى More, and most, adapted, disposed, apt, meet, suited, suitable, fitted, fit, competent, or proper; or more, and most, worthy, or deserving. (S, * Mgh, Msb, K.) A thing is said to be أَحْرَى بِٱلِاسْتِعْمَالِ [More, or most, meet, &c., to be done]. (S, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
